messages:
Mina: Huge thanks to @ops_jordan for swooping in on the staging incident and saving our Friday demo. You get 3 espresso points and a virtual high five :coffee::handshake:
ops_jordan: thanks! team debugging was clutch. special shoutout to @elle for spotting the env var mismatch. :eyes:
elle: omg I only noticed the typo in the var name while making toast. happy to help. :bread:
QA-Rob: also kudos to @Mina for the last-minute test harness tweak 12ms less flake rate on that suite.
DesignBot: New sticker created: "Debug Sherpa" 12 available in #stickers (credit: @ops_jordan). :sparkles:
Mina: yes sticker pls. can we print a couple for the whiteboard? small morale booster.
ops_jordan: if someone wants to collect them, I'll drop them on my desk on Monday. first come first serve.
elle: vote check: who wants iced lattes monday? react :ice_cream: for yes, :coffee: for hot, :no_entry: for nope.
QA-Rob: :ice_cream: but also extra props for the new flaky-test docs. saved my morning.
Mina: quick FYI to the team: if you closed any of the linked GH issues tonight, drop a one-line note here so we can add to the retro highlights.
elle: closed #4821 and #4823 12 small fixes, big mood.
ops_jordan: reverted the rogue config change and opened #4830 for follow-up.
Mina: nice. adding to retro draft. Thanks everyone 12 a lot of small wins today :tada:
